decisions.mark: distinguishes the two ways to substitute an allocator — a COMPILE-time pair of macros versus a RUNTIME pair of function pointers — and states that they are mutually exclusive
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "**Compile time:** define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... **Run time:** leave the macros undefined... `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`...
